known_limits: Voice/audio production validation is outside this release by explicit scope decision.
39 policy/safety-sensitive canonical facts await authorized domain-owner sign-off and are runtime-gated to staff confirmation until approved.
Historical raw HTML/PDF was not retained in v1.0.0; immutable evidence bundles are frozen in v1.0.1 and raw source archiving is mandatory on the next refresh.
Product-authored operational policies are workflow rules, not official Furama facts; live/secret/dynamic property data uses staff or authorized-tool confirmation.
Synthetic simulation and benchmark fixtures are isolated from canonical RAG truth.

Phase-1 Vietnamese guest-style additions are manually curated/synthetic and humanized for spoken naturalness; they are not observed guest transcripts. source_family=real remains reserved for de-identified utterances with auditable lineage.
The simulated_realistic guest-persona batch is synthetic/curated role-play, not observed guest speech; source_family=real remains reserved for de-identified utterances with auditable guest lineage.
Multilingual guest-persona support is simulated/curated rather than observed guest speech; source_family=real remains reserved for de-identified utterances with auditable lineage.
Runtime service-policy parity is not yet established: config/agent-domain.json remains authoritative; service_policies.json is an offline migration candidate only.
Training/evaluation expected_route labels are not yet proven one-to-one with the current runtime router/Command ontology; direct route-score comparison is blocked until that mapping is finalized.
Runtime migration remains blocked until exact service-policy and route/Command parity are verified against the current code bundle.
release_boundary: Canonical RAG truth is official/public Furama knowledge only. Product-authored operational policy may drive workflow behavior but cannot be presented as an official Furama claim.
